sections: 0. About this notice

This Privacy Notice (“Privacy Notice”) is issued by Tanla Platforms Limited (“Tanla”, “Company”, “we”, “us”, or “our”). This document describes how Tanla collects, records, evaluates, secures, and handles the Personal Data of individuals acting as authorized administrators, operational managers, technical personnel, or corporate representatives (“Platform Users”, “Corporate Users”, or “you”) on behalf of Senders (Enterprises), Telecom Service Providers (Access Providers / TSPs), Partners, Registered Telemarketers (RTMs) who access, integrate with, or operate our proprietary Wisely Consent Platform and its associated APIs and administrative interfaces (collectively, the “Platform”). This notice does not govern the underlying end-subscriber consumer communications data, for which your organization acts as the primary Data Fiduciary. You agree that these terms shall apply in conjunction with, and are additional to, the general Terms of Use, or any other agreement/terms governing your use of Wisely Consent Platform.
1. Personal data we process

The table below sets out the categories of personal data processed, why each is processed, and the services it enables.

Name, mobile number, email id, subscriber ID, user account ID or other platform identifier
Purpose: To identify you as the user and tie consent and communication preference records to the right profile, and to support account queries and grievances.
Enables: Account access, consent management, preference updates, retrieval of consent history, support.

Personal data in corporate KYC documents (directors' government IDs, authorised signatories, power of attorney, registration certificates)
Purpose: To run legal and technical risk assessments, verify corporate legitimacy, prevent identity fraud and validate the registering user's authority.
Enables: Completing onboarding, authorising high-volume consent migrations.

Consent status records: given, denied, modified, updated or withdrawn
Purpose: To keep a verifiable record of your consent choices.
Enables: Activation, denial, modification or revocation of promotional message and voice call preferences, per sender.

Communication preference settings (category, channel, other preferences)
Purpose: To record your preferences for promotional messages and voice calls.
Enables: Preference-based delivery of particular categories or channels.

Date, time and method of consent capture or withdrawal
Purpose: To create an auditable record of when and how a consent choice was made or changed.
Enables: Compliance validation, dispute resolution, audit trail, proof of consent lifecycle.

Platform logs: access and transaction logs, device or browser metadata, API access keys, IP address, session information
Purpose: To secure the Platform, detect misuse, troubleshoot issues and maintain integrity and auditability.
Enables: Secure access, fraud detection, monitoring, incident investigation, service continuity.

Grievance, complaint or support request details and correspondence
Purpose: To respond to your queries, requests, grievances and complaints.
Enables: Grievance redressal, support resolution, exercise of data principal rights.

Records of sharing consent instructions or preference updates with relevant Principal Entities, Senders or ecosystem participants
Purpose: To put your consent and preference choices into effect and pass updates to the parties who rely on them.
Enables: Applying updated consents and preferences; sender-side compliance.
2. Who we share it with

In order to make the Platform and its services available to you, we will need to share your personal data with certain third parties, such as authorised telecom service providers, technology service providers such as cloud hosting providers, database administrators and security log management vendors, government authorities, and third parties in case we undergo any mergers / acquisitions / investments / sale.

In such cases, to the extent permitted under applicable laws, we will ensure that the recipients of your personal data adopt appropriate security measures which are commensurate with the kind of personal data that they are accessing.
3. Your rights

As an individual acting as a Platform User, you may have the following rights in respect of the processing of your personal data under this Privacy Notice to the extent provided under applicable laws:

(a) the right to access, correct, and update your personal data;
(b) the right to request deletion of your personal information;
(c) the right to seek redressal of your grievances by us or the relevant authority;
and (d) the right to nominate one or more individuals to be able to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity.

To enable exercise of the above rights, please reach out to dpo@tanla.com. When reaching out to exercise your rights, please ensure you provide your name and phone number to help us identify you and support the exercise of your rights. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Board of India if you believe we have processed your personal information in violation of applicable data protection law. However, we encourage you to raise any complaint with us first so we can do our best to resolve it.
4. Security measures

We have implemented security policies, rules and technical measures, as required under applicable law including firewalls, transport layer security and other physical and electronic security measures to protect your personal data from inter alia unauthorised access, improper use or disclosure, unauthorised modification and unlawful destruction or accidental loss.
5. Consent

By clicking "Accept Privacy Policy", you acknowledge that:
a) You have read and understood how your personal data will be processed as per this Privacy Notice.
b) You hereby provide your consent to our processing of your personal information in accordance with this Privacy Notice. You have the right to withdraw your consent to processing of your personal information you have provided to us.
